lines.l: Can't follow the words when the silence holds everything
If it would show me the true me
On the top, it feels like right
Out my mind, it'll be just fine
Burning down, asking why another of my friends died
I can't have a coming down
Reflect a world that I could never find
Different roads the same backseat drive
If only we could see both sides
Burning all the trouble in the light Hoping it'll be revealed in due time
Let the eyes above the night light It's so bright
No need for proof, I can feel it too Let the eyes above the night light
So I don't need for proof I feel that you know
